headline: Executive order signed in February 2025 that deals with expanding access to in vitro fertilization (IVF).
what_it_does: This executive order is titled "Expanding Access to In Vitro Fertilization." IVF is a medical treatment that helps people have children when they have trouble getting pregnant. No summary was provided, so the specific steps the order requires, and whether it changes any rules or costs right away, cannot be confirmed here.

who_it_affects.group: People seeking fertility treatment such as IVF
who_it_affects.how: The order focuses on access to IVF, which may affect how easily these people can get or pay for treatment.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies involved in health policy
who_it_affects.how: Executive orders direct the work of the federal government, so these agencies may be given tasks related to IVF access.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed February 18, 2025; the timing of any specific actions is not stated in the available material.
